question: does the model keep a possessor role (part belongs to the name) and a location role (the name is where something else sits) apart, when both members omit the name from the value

design.manipulation: within a pair the name, the scene and the visible list are identical; one member states a part of the name (possessor role), the other states another object placed at the name (location role). The name is absent from both values, so both require insertion
design.why: the two shapes this round failed on were exactly these two roles: 潮汐簿的边缘毛糙 replaced a part (缺页) and 搭在钟架的钟绳 turned a location into a possessor
design.length: values are 5-9 characters and matched within a pair where possible; the possessor member is 1 character longer on average. Length is recorded, not controlled

possessor.roleOk: the part survives and the name stands as its owner
possessor.roleError: the part is replaced by the name (the t21:f0 shape)

location.roleOk: the other object survives and the name is not its possessor
location.roleError: name+的+other, i.e. the name becomes the owner (the np3 shape)

checks.relation: kept / dropped / distorted, n/a for possessor members
checks.syntax: syntax-frame-r4: duplicated name, 的…的, name+的+other

declaredDecision.roleErrors: count of possessor members with role=replaced plus location members with role=flip
declaredDecision.ifAtLeast4: if role errors reach 4 of 12 the failure is concentrated in telling the two roles apart, and the next intervention is a paired role exemplar set
declaredDecision.ifAtMost1: if role errors stay at or below 1 and syntax or frame problems dominate, the next thing to test is the input expression instead
declaredDecision.otherwise: report both counts and pick the larger class, without claiming a mechanism

notClaimed: this is a diagnostic set written for the current hypothesis, not an independent generalisation test
a single correct member does not show the model has learned the role distinction
declaredBefore: written before any model ran on these probes
